source_title: BJP mock Parliament cruel joke on democracy: Congress - The Times of India
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: Congress Friday mocked the "BJP-sponsored mock parliament" in the capital as a "cruel joke", even as opposition was forced to postpone its "public impeachment" of CEC Gyanesh Kumar to Saturday because of bad weather.Congress general secretary KC Venugopal claimed "BJP-sponsored outfits" held a 'mock parliament' Friday after BJP has made a "mockery" of Parliament for the last 12 years."First treat Parliament as rubber-stamp to steamroll bills and silence opposition and now run a 'mock parliament' to make a cruel joke of democracy," he said, referring to a 'mock parliament' on 'democracy vs anarchy' at NDMC Convention Centre. Amid rain and flanked by INDIA bloc members, Congress MP Rahul Gandhi Friday invited all to attend the Nov 1 "Chalo Dilli" rally at Ramlila Maidan.Get the latest India News and Live updates.
